readBy: the builder of Round 1510, desktop Claude lane
method: Every page was opened on the read day through a page reader that answers with lines quoted from the page; a literal is a line it quoted, cut short where the reader cut it. Curly quotes and apostrophes are written straight. The Sports Cast's, Outlook India's, Graphic Online's and Reuters' pages were found by a web search and then opened the same way. A date is the page's own; the Arsenal and Liverpool pages carry none and are marked undated.
limits: No copy of a page was kept, so there is no snapshot hash.

The official family's line for the 2026 decider is Liverpool FC's for the 2025 edition (no official 2026 page the reader opened says how a level match ends); the press line is the 2026 edition's (Sports Mole, 14 August 2026). The Premier League's explainer of 14 August 2026 and The FA's 2026 page do not say.
The double rule's official line is the Premier League's general explainer of 2026, not a rulebook; the press line (The Sports Cast) says the runners-up usually take the place.

Only England's 2026 row and its season one edition are verified. The four England era rows and the 2026 rows of Spain, Italy, Germany and France are toVerify: their candidates are memory or the other lane's notes, never facts, and the game plays no super cup for them.
The 2026 edition's real result and date are not recorded: the game plays its own season one, on its own calendar.
